_note: Vibration-only presets (our own designs). Levels are fractions of the calibrated felt range; 0 = off. Full-depth on/off stays >= 100 ms each (the motor needs ~40 ms to spin up and to stop); faster changes are shallow texture.

presets.label: Steady
presets.description: One constant level. Set it with Intensity.

presets.label: Slow pulse
presets.description: One second on, one second off.

presets.label: Knock
presets.description: A firm knock followed by three lighter ones, like knocking on a door.

presets.label: Heartbeat
presets.description: A lub-dub double beat at about 70 per minute.

presets.label: Breath
presets.description: Slow breathing: rises for 4 s, eases off for 6 s (about 6 breaths a minute).

presets.label: Tide
presets.description: A surge, a small ebb, a second surge, then the water draws back.

presets.label: Wave
presets.description: A smooth swell between gentle and full every 4 s.

presets.label: Stroke
presets.description: Rhythmic strokes at about 1.4 per second.

presets.label: Climb
presets.description: Rises steadily for 6 s, stops, and climbs again.

presets.label: Waterfall
presets.description: Up for 4 s, down for 4 s.

presets.label: Staircase
presets.description: Six steps up, each a quarter stronger than the last, 8 s each; a short rest, then again.

presets.label: Build
presets.description: Ninety seconds that get stronger and faster (0.5 to 3 pulses a second), a peak, then 20 s of rest.

presets.label: Tease
presets.description: Builds for 20 s, hovers near the top for 10 s, then stops for 15 s.

presets.label: Rhythm
presets.description: A swung five-in-eight beat at about 110 per minute, first beat accented.

presets.label: Flutter
presets.description: A fast shallow shimmer near full strength.
